target_statement: For the explicit precision-center-count-history state, a probability base mu, measurable variance a>0 and fixed nonnegative precision threshold, construct the same actual ideal target T and Gaussian observation H before arbitrary actual Markov Q and terminal L. Use the actual absorbed finite RGO transition P and output kernels R_n. Prove fiber KL measurability, and define e(s)=0 on stopped states and KL(Q(s)||H(s)) otherwise, t(s)=KL(L(s)||T(s)). Every error is integrated under actual Q or actual visited state laws. Include infinite-divergence and non-absolute-continuity cases without finite-KL, moment or assumed-measurability premises.
